messages:
elena: quick follow-up from today's postmortem: cross-region LB flip caused a short window where clients saw cert-mismatch -> retries -> a small retry-amplified outage.
vik: can you paste the minimal log snippet so ops has context?
elena: dropping it here
elena: ```
[2026-03-24T14:07:03Z] lb-us-west apply route-change -> target eu-central
[2026-03-24T14:07:04Z] backend-euc sidecar served old cert chain (CN=staging.example)
[2026-03-24T14:07:05Z] clients retried -> 502/504 spike observed
```
garth: looks like cert rollout lag to sidecars + immediate traffic cutover. two contributing factors: (1) cert distributor doesn't block route-change until sidecar ack, (2) LB flip script has 0s cooldown.
selena: mitigation proposals: A) add cert-ready handshake (sidecar -> distributor) before switching traffic, B) add a 10s cooldown after route-change, C) cap client retries in the edge proxy to 3 attempts with exponential jitter.
elena: temporary ops steps agreed: patch edge retry cap and add 8s cooldown on the flip script. longer-term: implement cert-ready handshake and a preflight check in the controller.
vik: i'll own the edge proxy retry cap. ETA: 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC. will push a canary to eu-central first.
garth: i'll update the flip script and add cooldown + safety checks. ETA: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/511
selena: i'll open an RFC for cert-ready handshake and coordinate with distributor team. target MVP ETA: 2026-04-07.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window for flip-script changes: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z
infra-oncall: will monitor during window and escalate if post-deploy TLS errors > 0.3% for 5m. paged if necessary. :rotating_light:
elena: owners + deadlines (recorded in PM doc): - vik: edge proxy retry cap + canary \u2014 ETA 2026-03-25 12:00 UTC; - garth: flip-script cooldown + PR \u2014 ETA 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC; - selena: cert-ready handshake RFC + plan \u2014 ETA 2026-04-07; - elena: verify metrics & close follow-ups \u2014 ETA 2026-03-27 10:00 PT
vik: noted a recurring pattern: small cert-propagation-induced spikes on 2025-11-05 and 2026-02-20. adding quarterly review task to PM doc.
selena: added links to the earlier incidents and the timeline in the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2026-03-24-lb-cert-prop
garth: PR opened and linked above. includes rollback steps and test checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy dq-2215 succeeded at 2026-03-25T02:07:58Z
infra-oncall: verified post-deploy metrics for 30m, TLS handshake errors within baseline. will leave follow-up check at 2026-03-27 10:00 PT.
elena: thanks everyone. follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-27 10:00 PT. please update the PM doc when your item is done.
